meta.title: Scott Football Coaching — Hillsborough County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Tampa, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Scott
about.bio: 3 time USA Hockey National Champion, OHL champion, with North American and European Pro experience. Member of the OHL Alumni Hall of Fame. Certified Athletic Trainer and Nutritionist. I work with players both on and off the ice working on both the physical and mental aspects of the game.

hero.headline: Hillsborough County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Scott changed the way I see the game. I went from second-string to starter in one season.
testimonials.name: Marcus T.

testimonials.quote: My son has trained with Coach Scott for two years. The improvement is night and day.
testimonials.name: Patricia L.
